_meta.task: 29/38 — make consolidation safe below the 0.92 threshold
_meta.headline: IDF-weighted overlap is refuted: the boilerplate it was supposed to down-weight is corpus-RARE (df 27-35 of 5964), so IDF scores it HIGH. The guard that works is one already in the repo — differs_by_value, shipped for write-time dedup. It blocks 391 of 396 pairs at 0.85 and lets genuine restatements through.

hypothesis_refuted_idf_weighted_overlap.claim_under_test: Tokens appearing across many memories (the boilerplate) get near-zero IDF weight; rare tokens carry the signal.
hypothesis_refuted_idf_weighted_overlap.why_it_fails: The boilerplate is not corpus-frequent. The 13-member agent-report cluster shares a template that appears in ~27 memories out of 5964, so its tokens carry idf 5.1-5.4 — among the highest in the vocabulary. IDF measures corpus rarity, not template-ness.
hypothesis_refuted_idf_weighted_overlap.verdict: The inversion the guard was built to fix survives IDF weighting intact. Not implemented.

second_hypothesis_also_refuted_within_cl.idea: Strip tokens shared by >=80% of a cluster's members, score the residual — genuine duplicates should have little residual, distinct memories a lot.
second_hypothesis_also_refuted_within_cl.verdict: Also inverted. A long shared template is the majority of each member's text, so it swamps any length-normalized measure. No token-overlap statistic separates these populations on this corpus.

shipped_value_token_guard.mechanism: differs_by_value(a, b) — already in core.py for write-time dedup (task 30). Refuse the merge when two members disagree about a version, dotted number, kebab/snake symbol, backticked literal or bare count.
shipped_value_token_guard.reuse: No new scoring function. One condition in pairwise mode, one whole-cluster check in cluster mode.

known_false_pass.case: Two agent-report memories whose only distinguishing tokens are a task title in prose and an agentId. The agentId is bare alphanumeric with no hyphen, underscore or dotted digit, so _VALUE_RE does not capture it and the pair reads as value-identical.
known_false_pass.cost: Both members are ~95% shared boilerplate; under the mmr_union default both task titles survive the merge. Not worth widening _VALUE_RE for — a looser pattern would start capturing ordinary words.

threshold_decision.why: With the guard on, dropping to 0.85 buys 5 merges across 5209 memories. The guard makes a lower threshold SAFE; it does not make it WORTHWHILE. This corpus has no duplicate mass left — consolidation has already eaten it.
threshold_decision.what_changed: The 149-distinct-memories-destroyed scenario is now unreachable through the shipped defaults, whatever threshold an operator passes.

incidental_fix.what: CLI --strategy default was keep_higher_recall while consolidate()'s own default is mmr_union.
incidental_fix.effect: Every `memory admin consolidate` invocation silently overrode the safer default shipped in task 13, reverting to the 62%-fact-retention strategy. Its own help text already said mmr_union was recommended.
incidental_fix.now: CLI default matches the API default.
